dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a smooth, concave curvature following a parabolic spline from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest point is classified as acute with a small-radius rounded tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin is inclined at approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the vertical height to the longitudinal base width is approximately 1.2:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon displays a continuous convex arc with a moderate radius of curvature transition from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: The beak is clearly defined with a linear taper; visible pixel length is approximately twice the thickness of the rostrum at the point of melon inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A distinct indentation forms an obtuse interior angle of approximately 140 degrees where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan/teal coloration and luminance across the entire visible surface area.
